meaning:
παρα-βάτης, -ου, ὁ
(παραβαίνω), [in Sm.: Psa.17:4 139:19, Jer.6:28 * ;]
1. one who stands beside, the warrior who stands by the charioteer (of. παραβαίνω, 1).
2. a transgressor (Æsch., παρβάτης): Gal.2:18, Jas.2:9; π. νόμου, Rom.2:25, 27, Jas.2:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
